## Easier installation and cache management
- Install with a DMG: open the disk image and drag DiskScope onto Applications, then eject the image and launch the installed app. - Select multiple cached scans in Settings and remove them together. - Choose how many cached scans to keep. The default is 20; oldest snapshots are removed first, with the existing cache size limit still applying. - See each cached scan’s completion date and time. - Remove an old cached snapshot while that location is scanning. The scan continues and can save a fresh snapshot when it finishes.
Removing cached snapshots never removes the scanned files or saved locations. Automatic updates continue through DiskScope’s signed update feed.
Apple Silicon · macOS 14 or later. This free release is self-signed and unnotarized; macOS may require first-launch approval in Privacy & Security. Full Disk Access and other privacy grants remain under your control.
